proofLimits: Real unmodified animation/wall clock; no application/model import, private state, score fixture or synthetic DOM events.

The visual pilot reads only actual Canvas next-ring accent components and public HUD distance. Its screen-space aim curve is a camera calibration, not a flight-state simulator.
Whole original viewport PNGs are retained separately; automated pixels are not human visual, physical-device, acoustic or performance acceptance.
Authored corrupt owned JSON and unrelated one-time sentinels are the only injected storage fixtures. Actual course records are earned through controls.
Prior native/scientific/source receipts remain bound to original sources; this generated edition and anonymous hosted publication are separate.
The new short free entry does not qualify beyond-finish native generated free flight. Unchanged range/physics constraints have their separately pinned Node evidence.
